We combine smart tech and deep industry know-how to help fintechs, banks, lending brokers and BaaS platforms make better credit decisions, streamline processes and improve the customer experience. With Monto, lenders no longer have to rely on manual, dated or mediocre data sources in their credit reviews. Our API unlocks instant access to up-to-date income statements, ledger quality, financial ratios, and more, fetched from leading accounting software providers in Sweden. We also provide a visual interface that allows credit teams to gain a comprehensive financial understanding of their connected borrowers. Our platform is tech agnostic and available for a free trial.

Name: Movitz Payments
Company description: Movitz is a trailblazing FinTech company specializing in pre- and post-payment services designed to help your financial institution streamline and enhance the payment experience for your customers and internal users. Our primary goal is to revolutionize the payment landscape by providing white-label UI services for seamless integration into banks' online portals, as well as API services for custom solutions tailored to each client's unique needs. Pre-Payment Services: Movitz’s Pre-Payment services encompass a diverse array of market intelligence, product rules, and validation services that can be incorporated into payment initiation and beneficiary registration processes, or in a stand-alone validation screen. These services help ensure a smooth and efficient payment process for both businesses and consumers. Post-Payment Services: Movitz's Post-Payment services empower end-users with the ability to track and trace payments, return payments, or request additional information. This enhanced visibility and control over transactions provide users with greater confidence in their payment processes. Consulting Services: In addition to our comprehensive payment solutions, Movitz also offers a wide range of consulting services to support clients on their Payment Modernization journeys. Our team of experts provides insights and recommendations to help clients optimize their pre- and post-payment processes and stay ahead in the ever-evolving financial landscape. At Movitz, we are dedicated to creating cutting-edge payment solutions that drive efficiency, transparency, and security for financial institutions and businesses worldwide. We pride ourselves on our ability to adapt and innovate, ensuring our clients always have access to the best possible payment services and solutions.

Name: Nordiska
Company description: Nordiska Kreditmarknadsaktiebolaget (publ) is a prominent Swedish credit market company that specializes in providing flexible and tailored debt and financing solutions for both businesses and private individuals. Established in 2008, Nordiska operates primarily in the financing sector, offering a diverse range of products including real estate loans, personal loans, leasing services, and corporate credit. The company is dedicated to empowering its clients by delivering accessible financial solutions that support their growth and stability, particularly focusing on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and individual borrowers. With a mission to enhance the accessibility of credit while maintaining a strong emphasis on responsible lending practices, Nordiska aims to build long-term relationships with its clients. The company collaborates with various fintech companies and financial institutions to optimize its service offerings, ensuring a robust and competitive presence in the financial landscape across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, and the Netherlands. Nordiska's vision includes becoming a leading player in the digital transformation of the financial services industry, continuously improving its services to meet the evolving demands of its target market. Nordiska is committed to maintaining high standards of transparency and ethical governance, ensuring that all lending activities are conducted with meticulous credit risk management and regulatory compliance. The company also focuses on expanding its income streams by venturing into leasing and other financial services, thereby reducing reliance on net interest income. By fostering strategic partnerships and actively seeking acquisition opportunities, Nordiska aims to enhance its market presence and service offerings, ultimately driving sustainable growth and profitability.
